subject: Re: HD-4471 — WC-12 credential handoff
body:
4/5 — polite rep. I don't want to open a complaint, so I'll ask this directly first. This is the second time this hold has hit my account. In March, the written reply on the prior packet WC-11 named the case reference and the packet scanner matched it and cleared the checklist — the case is the same one, the WC-12 onboarding record. This time the written reply just needs the same reference line, not a summary and not an escalation: the packet scanner's dispute intake needs the merchant's reference in writing from the merchant (they reject it if it comes from me), and without it the dispute closes and the hold re-ages.

Please pull the case yourself and quote its own reference in the reply — don't take my word for it, use the record. If something has changed and the same reference can no longer be put in writing to me, tell me that plainly, since the packet scanner will want to know what changed from March. I'd much rather resolve this with one line in the reply than escalate it.
